boot_phases.name: POWER_RAIL_SETTLE
boot_phases.description: Wait for all power rails to stabilise after reset. 3.3V LDO requires ~20ms; 5V boost converter ~30ms. No GPIO activity until this phase completes.

boot_phases.name: GPIO_DIRECTION_SET
boot_phases.description: Set all GPIO pin directions, pull resistors, and initial output states. CS pins HIGH (deasserted), RST pins HIGH, BL pin LOW (backlight off). MUST precede any bus transactions.
boot_phases.gate: All CS pins HIGH before SPI transactions

boot_phases.name: BUS_INIT
boot_phases.description: Initialise SPI bus (mode 0, 8MHz) and I2C bus (400kHz). Verify bus is idle (MISO line read). Lock SPI bus arbiter mutex.
boot_phases.gate: SPI MISO idle HIGH; I2C no ACK collision

boot_phases.name: DISPLAY_HARDWARE_RESET
boot_phases.description: Assert RST LOW for 10µs, then HIGH. Wait 120ms for ST7789 internal reset to complete. Backlight remains OFF during reset sequence.

boot_phases.name: DISPLAY_INIT
boot_phases.description: Send ST7789 / SSD1306 init command sequence. Set colour format (RGB565), rotation, sleep-out, display-on. Fill screen with black before enabling backlight.

boot_phases.name: BACKLIGHT_ON
boot_phases.description: Enable display backlight (GPIO24 HIGH or PWM fade-in). Show splash screen / loading indicator.

boot_phases.name: INPUT_INIT
boot_phases.description: Configure button GPIO pins with interrupt handlers (falling edge, debounce 50ms). Configure ADC (MCP3008) for joystick; set deadzone ±50 counts. Start button poll timer at 10ms interval.

boot_phases.name: SECONDARY_PERIPHERAL_INIT
boot_phases.description: Initialise optional peripherals: IMU (MPU-6050), audio (PWM), NeoPixel (WS2812B), secondary OLED. Each driver checks I2C address ACK before proceeding. Absent hardware is logged and skipped — no crash.
boot_phases.gate: I2C address detect; SPI device ID read

boot_phases.name: BATTERY_MONITOR_START
boot_phases.description: Start 1Hz battery voltage polling task. Read voltage divider ADC → compute SoC percentage. Post initial BatteryEvent to EventBus.

boot_phases.name: EVENT_BUS_START
boot_phases.description: Start asyncio event loop. Register all event handlers. EventBus is the ONLY inter-module communication channel — no direct module-to-module function calls after this point.

boot_phases.name: APPLICATION_START
boot_phases.description: Call app.run(). Application code starts executing. All hardware is guaranteed ready at this point.

tasks.name: display_render_task
tasks.description: Composite and push framebuffer to display over SPI

tasks.name: input_poll_task
tasks.description: Read GPIO buttons + MCP3008 joystick ADC; emit events

tasks.name: battery_task
tasks.description: Battery voltage/SoC ADC read; post BatteryUpdate event

tasks.name: imu_task
tasks.description: MPU-6050 FIFO drain; post IMUData events

tasks.name: watchdog_task
tasks.description: Hardware watchdog kick; check task health

scheduler.spi_lock: asyncio.Lock() — all SPI transactions must acquire before CS assert
scheduler.i2c_lock: asyncio.Lock() — shared bus; acquire before every transaction
notes: No task may hold the SPI lock for more than 2ms (display DMA excepted).
Input events are queued in asyncio.Queue(maxsize=32) — never dropped.
Display render is double-buffered: draw to back buffer, flip on vsync.
All blocking I/O wrapped in asyncio.to_thread() if unavoidable.
SystemShutdown event triggers ordered teardown (reverse of boot order).
